artworks.title: The Island of Madonna della Grazia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with a grand church featuring a tall bell tower. The horizon is marked by the church spire, with rooftops dominating the horizon line. Small boats with figures are visible in the foreground. The church's architecture is detailed with brushstrokes indicating windows and arches. The color palette is muted, with sepia tones creating an aged feel. The sky and water are depicted with light washes, while the buildings and trees are outlined with darker strokes.

artworks.title: Head of a Child
artworks.medium: black and red chalks heightened with white chalk on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a young child. The child is positioned with their face slightly turned to the right, looking upward. Their facial features are soft and round, with large, expressive eyes and full cheeks. The child's lips are slightly parted. They have short hair covered by a cap or bonnet with ruffled edges. The child is wearing a simple garment without visible patterns or adornments. There is no jewelry or objects held by the child. The background is plain with a neutral, textured surface.

artworks.title: Drawing for a Ceiling Fresco
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over (graphite?)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in motion with flowing drapery. The artwork depicts two figures intertwined, with one appearing to lift the other. The figures are rendered in a sepia-toned illustrative style, emphasizing the contours and flow of their bodies and garments. The background is blank, focusing attention on the central figures. The lines suggest detail to anatomy and expression, while the use of sepia highlights shadow and form, creating a dramatic play of light and dark.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt with the Holy Family and Two Angels in a Skiff
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group in a boat with winged figures. The drawing shows several winged figures gathered around a seated figure holding a child. The figures are depicted with flowing robes and wings. The composition is dynamic, with movement of wings and clothing creating drama. The scene is set against rocky formations, and the lines and shading are gentle and fluid.

artworks.title: Drover with Calves in a Country Cart
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a low horizon, distant hills, sparse trees, and a wooden cart being drawn by two oxen with a man on top. There are clouds above the horizon and the brushstrokes create texture, capturing details like the cart's wood grain and foliage tufts. The color scheme is monochromatic, suggesting the image is a drawing or print, evoking a serene atmosphere. The ground is textured with rocks along a pathway leading towards the cart and the countryside.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view portrait of a woman, capturing her from the waist up. She is positioned facing slightly to her right with her head slightly turned toward the viewer. The woman's facial features are softly defined, with a delicate expression, subtle smile, and large eyes gazing forward. Her hair is curly, spilling out from beneath a fabric cap or headdress that covers most of her head. She is wearing a light-colored, ruffled gown with a low neckline that highlights her graceful neck, around which she wears a simple pearl necklace. The background is plain and unembellished, emphasizing the subject herself, and the oval shape of the portrait gives a classic and elegant framing to the composition.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Violinist Tuning His Instrument
artworks.medium: black and red chalk heightened with white chalk on light brown laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The image depicts two sketches of a man playing the violin. In both sketches, the man is shown in a slightly bent posture, focusing on the violin. The man's facial features are rough but expressive, with prominent cheekbones and a subtle smile in one of the images. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and a loose-fitting jacket. The man holds a violin and bow, with the violin under his chin. The background is plain with the texture of the paper visible.

artworks.title: Parade (A Theatrical Procession in Paris)
artworks.medium: black chalk with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene featuring an architectural structure with a crowd gathered in front of it. The drawing depicts a large group of people gathered in front of a structure with classical architectural elements such as columns and a triangular pediment. Within the pediment, there are sculptural details. The figures in the foreground appear to be engaging in various activities. The use of muted brown tones and soft blue touches in the sky gives the piece an atmospheric quality. The overall style captures movement and social interaction.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Boy
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on heavy brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a young child facing slightly to the right. The child has a slight tilt to their head and a gentle expression. They have softly curled hair, bright eyes, soft eyebrows, a small nose, and full lips. The child is wearing a buttoned garment with a visible white shirt collar. One of their hands is raised to their chest with slightly curled fingers. The background has a textured appearance with a muted color.

artworks.title: A Young Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person seated sideways with one leg crossed over the other. The individual has wavy, short hair, facial features with a slight profile view, and is wearing a loose, flowing garment with detailed sketch lines showing folds and creases. The background is lightly sketched with abstract lines and shapes, possibly indicating a wall or draped fabrics. The drawing is done in sepia and light brown hues on a textured background, with no visible jewelry or objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man
artworks.medium: silverpoint on pink prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of an elderly man in profile. The man has a prominent nose, pronounced cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a long beard. His hair flows seamlessly into his beard. He is not wearing any clothing or accessories. The drawing is on pink paper and in the upper left corner, there is a signature and date, "A. Regno 1897." The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Big Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a dense, wooded area with two large trees framing the scene. The textured bark and abundant foliage are depicted with intricate brushstrokes. More trees in the distance suggest a horizon line. The brush technique conveys movement and growth. The color palette is sepia with shades of brown and beige. A horizontal log is visible beneath the trees.

artworks.title: Head of a Child
artworks.medium: goldpoint on blue prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a pencil sketch of a child's head and partial shoulders. The child is portrayed in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The drawing includes detailed facial features such as round cheeks, a small nose, full lips, wide eyes looking towards the right, and curly hair. The background is a plain, light-toned paper with no other elements present, emphasizing the child's portrait.

artworks.title: Corner of a Wood (Coin d'un bois)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with tall trees in the foreground. The tree trunks rise from the ground, covered in detailed foliage. In the background, there are rolling hills with a soft brushstroke texture, creating depth. The horizon line is in the upper third of the image, marked by curved hills. The artwork uses fine cross-hatching to add texture and depth, with a monochromatic color palette of black and white for contrast and dimension.

artworks.title: Bank of a River
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawing with a body of water leading towards trees and a house in a scenic setting. The hills and the architectural structure imply the horizon. The style includes cross-hatching and linear strokes for texture. The color palette is in sepia tones. The water has softened lines, and the vegetation and trees are detailed. The drawing leads the eye towards the house partially hidden by nature, with trees in the background.

artworks.title: English Beggars
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 15 x 14.9 cm (5 7/8 x 5 7/8 in.)
support: 18 x 17.4 cm (7 1/16 x 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a painting of a garden scene with figures seated and standing in contemplation. The image depicts a group of four figures, three of which are seated near a building with horizontal lines indicating bricks. The seated figures appear in various poses of meditation or contemplation with foliage surrounding them. To the right, there is a standing figure cloaked in heavy drapery next to the building. In the background, beyond the walls and seated figures, soft brushwork and washes of watercolor render the subtle outlines of hills or trees.

artworks.title: Birch Trees along the Water (Les bouleaux: Bord de l'eau)
artworks.medium: drypoint and (etching?)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a forest path winding through dense trees, branches, and foliage. The perspective is slightly elevated to reveal the path extending into the distance, with the horizon obscured by the trees. The trees vary in height and create a sense of depth. The brushstrokes are fine, with thin lines suggesting texture and form. The color palette is primarily beige and off-white, creating a subdued visual effect. The path and trees fade in the distance, enhancing the depth of the image.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.dimensions:
support: 39.8 x 61.5 cm (15 11/16 x 24 3/16 in.)
support (sealed mount): 59.7 x 80 cm (23 1/2 x 31 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with fields, a hilltop with structures in the distance, and a sky with faint clouds. The artwork features loose, broad brushstrokes and fine lines for texture on trees and structures. The color palette is predominantly sepia tones. Close to us are shrubbery and trees, while figures are shown engaging in activities in the distance.

artworks.title: Landscape - Four Trees beyond a River
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a riverbank, bushes, and trees reflected on the water. The horizon is low in the composition, and the brushstrokes are soft and minimalistic. The color palette is muted sepia tones.

artworks.title: Mountains Seen beyond a Lake
artworks.medium: gouache
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with water, trees, mountains, and a sailing ship. The composition includes vegetation, two trees in the foreground, and a serene color palette dominated by earthy tones of brown, green, and blues.

artworks.title: Landscape: Sunrise (Paysage: Lever du soleil)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon, water meeting a line of trees in the distance. The etching technique features cross-hatching for texture and depth. The style conveys softness and movement, especially in the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using variations of black, gray, and the paper tone. Two figures are seated in the foreground, partially hidden by vegetation.

artworks.title: Traveler Reclining on the Grass (Le voyageur etendu sur le gazon)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A figure lies on the ground facing the scene, with two trees to the left. The horizon is formed by distant hills and foliage. The artwork is detailed with fine brushstrokes in a monochromatic scheme of soft sepia tones.

artworks.title: Landscape with Birch Trees (Le paysage aux bouleaux)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a path winding through a dense forest. The path curves into the distance, surrounded by trees that create a natural archway. The fine lines create textures of tree bark and the ground. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of black and sepia on a cream background. Trees line both sides of the path, partially obscuring the view ahead.

artworks.title: Large Trees Seen against the Sun  (Les grandes arbres: Effet du soir)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a dense forest with tall, dark trees. The trunks have textured markings resembling rough bark. The trees create a vertical rhythm leading upward to sparse branches against a hazy sky. There is a subtle horizon with a glowing light beyond the trees. The scene appears to be either a forest opening or at dusk or dawn. The etching technique utilizes fine, linear marks to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, consisting of black, gray, and soft white tones, evoking a serene and tranquil ambiance.
